headline: IMD RED ALERT: Flash Flood Warning for Mithi River Catchment
description: Rapid water level rise detected along Mithi River basin. Inundation depth exceeding 0.7m expected in next 60 minutes.
instruction: Avoid low-lying subways and basement areas. Move to designated relief shelters or upper floors immediately.
area_description: Kurla West & Dharavi Basin (Ward L & G/North)

headline: CIVIC TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Arterial Road Closures & Waterlogging
description: Severe water accumulation under King's Circle Flyover and CST Road Bridge. Arterial transit restricted to single lane.
instruction: Mithi Canal Road closed by police. Divert to Eastern High Ground Elevated Corridor. Avoid vehicle transit through water >0.3m.
area_description: CST Road Bridge & King's Circle Dadar

headline: CIVIL DEFENSE ADVISORY: 24/7 Relief Havens & Medical Bases Open
description: Emergency civil defense relief havens opened with backup power generation and drinking water supplies.
instruction: Sion Municipal General Hospital (+5.4m MSL) active with 120 emergency beds. Citizens in flooded zones should evacuate.
area_description: Sion Municipal General Hospital & Ward Relief Havens
